messages:
Alex: Draft of the launch blog is up in the doc: https://docs.google.com/draft (section 'Benchmarks' has a placeholder chart). Can people skim?
Maya: Skimming now. Quick note — headline should call out cost savings + latency, not just 'scale'.
Tom: Agreed. Also want to surface one play-by-play benchmark (small/mid/large) instead of a big table. Readers like a single clear stat.
Alex: OK will surface p95 gen for 1/10/100 concurrent sessions. Current quick numbers from the benchmark run: p95 = 120ms (1), 240ms (10), 680ms (100).
Sophie: Legal here — avoid absolute SLA claims. Fine to publish test harness numbers as "lab results". Please add a short methodology blurb: test harness, model version, region, instance types.
Alex: Will add methodology section. Adding: "Harness: internal loadrunner v2; model: open-rdw-7b; infra: g4dn-like; seed: fixed; prompt length: 128 tokens" in code block.
Maya: For CTAs — we need 1) Register for demo webinar, 2) Try the hosted sandbox, 3) Contact sales for Dedicated. Make the primary CTA webinar this week.
Aiden: Webinar planning: I can host Tue 11am PT demo. Need: 15-min product demo, 20-min bench walk-through, 10-min Q&A. Speakers: Maya + Tom + Eng TL (TBD).
Luis: Uploaded final hero and 3 variant thumbnails to Figma: https://figma.com/file/hero-final. Use thumb-B for blog list.
Alex: UTM set for the webinar CTA: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=redwood_demo_mar2026
Tom: Suggest adding a short quote from the bench run: "~3x cost reduction vs naive batching" — Sophie: we need the data/footnote for that claim.
Sophie: Provide the calculation or change wording to "cost reduction observed in our tests" with a link to the appendix.
Alex: Changed line to: "cost reduction observed in our tests (see appendix)." Appendix will include table + calculation snippet.
Maya: Inbound lead routing — Sales Ops, can you ensure leads from blog CTA are tagged 'source: launch_blog' and 'nurture: webinar_march'?
Sales Ops: Yep — will add lead mapping. Also add field 'interest: dedicated_or_hosted' as a checkbox so SDRs can route.
Alex: Promo plan — send one teaser email to newsletter, post to X/LinkedIn morning of publish, and a targeted outreach to top 50 accounts (AE list).
Aiden: For the webinar registration page, please use this placeholder: https://events.redwood.ai/register-demo. Also add an optional checkbox: "Share anonymized usage for benchmarking".
Maya: Quick copy edit: change paragraph 3 to remove passive voice and tighten CTAs. Pushing updates in the doc.
Tom: Can marketing-bot run the checklist once we final?
marketing-bot: Reminder — publish checklist: hero image, legal signoff, UTM, CTAs, webinar reg, lead mapping, SEO meta. Due: EOD Wednesday.
Alex: Status: Legal = Sophie ✅, Hero = Luis ✅, Webinar page = Aiden (needs form field), Lead routing = Sales Ops (pending mapping).
Luis: Also uploaded demo deck v1 (slides 1-12). Link in the doc. Feedback welcome.
Maya: Last ask — add one short customer-facing FAQ about dedicated vs hosted for cost predictability. I'll draft.
Tom: Small visuals ask: add a one-line callout box with 'What this means for engineers' — Ben in design can do.
Alex: OK team — plan: finalize doc by Wed noon PT, lock hero + deck, legal approved, and publish Thursday 10:00 AM PT with webinar CTA live. Everyone good?
All: :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks. I'll post the final publish checklist here when locked.
Sophie: Approved copy for publish.
Sales Ops: Routing set — demo leads go to webinar_march list and tag fields added.
marketing-bot: Posted: publish checklist due meters. :bell:
Alex: Publishing scheduled in CMS for Thursday 10:00 AM PT. I'll ping again when live.
Maya: Great work team — let's keep the demo script tight.
Tom: I'll rehearse slides with Eng on Mon.
Luis: Uploaded alt text for hero and thumbnails.
Alex: Closing thread — final doc link in pinned message. :tada:
